run_multilayer_gradient_descent: run the multilayer ReLU network gradient descent experiment with teacher and student weight matrices
compute_gradient_deltaWs: compute the gradient delta weight matrices between teacher and student networks for all layers
compute_corrs_layer_wise: compute layer-wise correlation matrices between teacher and student network activations across all layers
compute_H_Hessian_terms: compute the H and beta Hessian-like terms propagated backward through the network layers
compute_stats_evaluation: compute evaluation statistics including max correlations, zero counts, and loss between teacher and student
